raw:
Brendon Hartley started F1 races for only one team between 2000 and 2025: Toro Rosso (Scuderia Toro Rosso). The search results show him in Toro Rosso colours in 2018 (for example, 9th at the 2018 United States GP and 10th at the 2018 German GP). The results don't show him racing for any other team, and my searches for 2019–2021 found no sign of him in a race. The 2017 results didn't list him directly, so that season rests on what I know rather than on a retrieved report. Toro Rosso is the only team I could place him with.

ANSWER: 1
